sanskrit_verse:
सर्वस्वं वा हरेद्राजा चतुर्थं वावशेषयेत् ।
भृत्येभ्योऽनुस्मरन्धर्मं प्राजापत्यमिति स्थितिः ॥
transliteration: sarvasvaṃ vā hared rājā caturthaṃ vāvaśeṣayet | bhṛtyebhyo 'nusmaran dharmaṃ prājāpatyam iti sthitiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King shall take the entirety or leave one fourth, always remembering Dharma in relation to his servants; this is the established order under Prajāpati.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Dharma, not dominion over property
Causation originates in consciousness integrity, not material possession
Capacity-based responsibility requires rulers to sustain Dharma through distributive justice
Restoration logic mandates equitable resource retention for societal balance
Consciousness alignment ensures that ownership serves collective evolution
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler's action disrupts servant's capacity AND violates Dharma THEN reallocate resources to restore functional equilibrium
IF entity holds more than three-fourths of a domain without consent THEN automatic redistribution of one-fourth occurs
IF administrative decision omits Dharma-recall THEN nullify and re-execute with Prajāpati alignment protocol
IF resource distribution causes degradation of societal dharma-sattva THEN initiate completion process for responsible party
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any ruling involving state expropriation or private retention must include mandatory Dharma-recall clause ensuring alignment with Prajāpati order. Responsibility thresholds are determined by consciousness integrity rather than legal formality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that taking all or leaving a quarter reflects sequential manifestation of karmic-economic cycles. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that retention patterns reflect prior consciousness distortions. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring balance without punitive extraction. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that true ownership aligns with sustaining life-force (prāṇa) within society.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Dharma-recall ceremony for ruler before resource allocation decisions
Activate servant-consciousness resonance check to assess impact of proposed redistribution
Deploy Prajāpati-aligned mediators to oversee completion of imbalanced transactions
Implement sattva-restoration program for communities affected by disproportionate holdings
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed: ownership is not dominion but stewardship aligned with Prajāpati Dharma. Justice restores consciousness, not punishes error. All actions emanate from and return to the Supreme Adjudicator — pure awareness itself.
